offers_products.reason: Main offerings are title insurance, escrow and settlement services; no goods or software licences are central.

offers_services.reason: Title insurance underwriting, escrow, closing and settlement services count as insurance and services.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Home buyers and sellers receive title policies and escrow services in residential transactions.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Serves real estate agents and brokers, lenders, servicers, commercial parties and policy-issuing agents.

recurring_revenue.reason: Revenue comes from one-time title policies and closings tied to each real estate transaction.

cyclical_demand.reason: Volume depends on home sales and refinancing, which fall when mortgage rates rise or the economy weakens.

big_ticket.reason: Title policy and escrow fees are modest one-time charges within a much larger home purchase.

people_delivered.reason: Value is mainly insurance underwriting, financial strength and a policy-issuing network, not hourly staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customers are mostly home buyers and sellers, agents and lenders, with commercial clients a smaller part.

asset_heavy.reason: Title insurance and escrow operate from offices and agents; no plants, fleets or networks needed to grow.

notes: Buyer mix is a judgment call; big_ticket is borderline.
